subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: VPNs Explained
description: A quick win: understand VPNs Explained.

hook.text: A VPN hides your IP address and encrypts your connection. But it's not the invisibility cloak ads claim.

buildup.text: VPNs route your traffic through a server elsewhere, masking your location from websites and ISPs.

discovery.text: They're useful on public Wi-Fi and for bypassing geo-restrictions. They prevent basic IP tracking.

twist.text: But your VPN provider can see everything your ISP could. You're just moving trust, not eliminating it.

climax.text: VPNs are one layer of protection, not a complete solution. They help, but they don't make you invisible.

punchline.text: A VPN shifts who watches. It doesn't stop watching.

quiz.question: What is the main limitation of using a VPN for privacy?
options: You transfer trust to the VPN provider instead of your ISP
VPNs make your internet connection slower only
VPNs are illegal in most countries
